title: Change the policy itself
hook: Trace one sampled return through two policy parameters.

knows: The listed prerequisite concepts and small arithmetic.
doesNotKnow: Apply a score-function policy gradient to softmax logits after a sampled episode.

misconception: Apply a score-function policy gradient to softmax logits after a sampled episode.
objective: Apply a score-function policy gradient to softmax logits after a sampled episode.

claims.text:
All finite inputs, equations, computed outputs and visual encodings: export function update(action:number,g:number,eta=.5){const old=[.5,.5],grad=old.map((p,i)=>(i===action?1:0)-p),delta=grad.map(v=>eta*g*v),e=delta.map(Math.exp),p=e.map(v=>v/(e[0]+e[1]));return {action,g,grad,delta,p};}
export function run(mode:number){return update(mode===3?1:0,[2,0,-2,2][mode]);}

claims.text: The sampled Left return 2 multiplied its log-probability gradient (.5, −.5). With step size .5, the two logits changed by (.5, −.5), and Left’s probability rose from .500 to .731. This update changed the stochastic policy directly. Zero return makes no change; a negative return reverses this sample’s direction. One update is not a guarantee of better performance.
